entities.name: PMID:27510251
observations: Ramachandran et al. reported a South Indian tuberculosis cohort study of SLCO1B1 variants and plasma rifampicin concentration (2016).

entities.name: SLCO1B1
observations: Variants rs11045819, rs4149032, and rs4149033 were evaluated for association with rifampicin concentration in South Indian adults with tuberculosis.

entities.name: No SLCO1B1 effect on 2h rifampicin
observations: In 256 South Indian adult tuberculosis patients, 2-hour post-dose rifampicin plasma concentrations did not differ significantly across genotypes for rs11045819, rs4149032, or rs4149033; abstract does not report Cmax or AUC.
